name: tanstackstart-react

scripts.build: node start-mock-sentry-server.mjs & vite build > .tmp_build_stdout 2> .tmp_build_stderr; BUILD_EXIT=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; if [ $BUILD_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then cat .tmp_build_stdout; cat .tmp_build_stderr >&2; fi; exit $BUILD_EXIT
scripts.test:build-latest: pnpm add @tanstack/react-start@latest @tanstack/react-router@latest nitro@latest vite@latest @vitejs/plugin-react-swc@latest vite-tsconfig-paths@latest && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.test:assert:proxy: pnpm test && TEST_ENV=development pnpm playwright test db-drivers

//: Need to use ioredis 5.10.1 because that's the last version before they support tracing channels
